entries.def:
ἀστατέω, -ῶ
(ἄστατος, unstable), [in Aq.: Isa.58.7 (LXX, ἄστεγος)* ;] 
to be unsettled, be homeless, lead a vagabond life (Cremer, 738 MM, see word): 1Co.4.11 †
(AS)

ἀστεῖος, -ον
(ἄστυ, a city), [in LXX: Exo.2.2 (טוֹב), Num.22.32 (οὐκ ἀ. יָרַט), Jdg.3.17 (בָּרִיא), Jdt.11.23, Dan LXX, Sus.1.7, 2Ma.6.23 * ;] 
__1. of the town. 
__2. (Like Lat. urbanus), 
__(a) courteous, 
__(b) elegant (in π., of clothing, MM, see word), comely, fair (as in Ex, l.with), Heb.11.23, Act.7.20.† 
(AS)

ἀστήρ, -έρος, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for כּוֹכָב ;] 
a star: Mat.2.2, 7-10 :, Mrk.13.25, 1Co.15.41, Rev.6.13; 8.10-12; 9.1; 12.1, 4; metaphorically, ὁ ἀ. ὁ πρωϊνός Rev.2.28; 22.16; ἀ. πλαῆται, Jude.13; ἀ. ἑπτά, symbolizing the angels of the seven churches, Rev.1.16, 20; 2.1; 3.1 (cf. ἄστρον, and see DCG, ii, 674 f.; MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἄστοργος, -ον
(στοργή, family affection, love of kindred, see: ἀγάπη) 
without natural affection: Rom.1.31, 2Ti.3.3 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἀστοχέω, -ῶ
(στόχος, a mark), [in LXX: Sir.7.19; 8.9 * ;] 
to miss the mark, fail: with genitive, 1Ti.1.6 (so in π., MM, see word); before περί, 1Ti.6.21, 2Ti.2.18.†
(AS)

ἀστραπή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX for בָּרָק ;] 
lightning: Mat.24.27; 28.3, Luk.10.18; 17.24; pl., Rev.4.5; 8.5; 11.19; 16.18; of a lamp, shining brightness, Luk.11.36.†
(AS)

ἀστράπτω 
[in LXX for בָּרָק ;] 
to lighten, flash forth: Luk.17.24; 24.4 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

ἄστρον, -ου, τό 
[in LXX chiefly for כּוֹכָב ;] 
__(a) mostly in pl. (as in cl.), the stars: Luk.21.25, Act.27.20, Heb.11.12; 
__(b) in sing. (Xen., al.), only of some noted star; the symbol or image of a star, Act.7.43 (cf. ἀστήρ, and see MM, see word).†
(AS)
